reason: Critical requirements are unmet: forecast not initialized from last training day, no calibration despite CMA-ES spec, and missing agent-level predictions. Addressing these will materially improve accuracy and compliance. We are at iteration 0 of 3, so there is room for significant improvement.

specific_areas: Initialize forecast from the last observed training day (e.g., day 29) and simulate only the prediction window (days 30–39).
Implement parameter calibration (CMA-ES if available, otherwise random/Nelder-Mead) minimizing RMSE on training days.
Record and export agent-level predictions (mask state per agent) for days 30–39.
Fix threshold timing to return actual day numbers, not indices.
Optional performance optimization of neighbor computations (scipy.sparse fallback).
Add inequality metrics by SES if available; document if not.
Align synthetic population default with spec (10,000) or make configurable via parameters.

task_understanding.adjustments: Reaffirm that forecasts must start from the last observed training state, include a calibration routine per spec (CMA-ES), and output agent-level behaviors for days 30–39.

data_analysis.adjustments: Derive per-agent states on the last training day and compute time_since_first_info from training history. Define the training target series (aggregate adoption days 0–29) and a baseline RMSE. Detect availability of SES for inequality metrics.

model_planning.adjustments: Select a parsimonious set of tunable parameters with bounds (e.g., base_adoption_rate, beta_family/work/community, messaging_effect_size, enforcement_elasticity). Choose optimizer (CMA-ES with fallback) and objective (RMSE on training). Plan state injection for forecast initialization and design data structures for agent-level outputs.

code_generation.adjustments: Modify simulation to initialize from day 29 states and run only days 30–39. Implement calibration loop with budgeted iterations and reproducible seeding. Add agent-level prediction logging and CSV export. Correct time_to_thresholds to map to actual days. Make synthetic population size configurable (default 10,000). Optionally add sparse-based neighbor computations with graceful fallback.

code_verification.adjustments: Add checks/tests to confirm forecast starts from day 29 state, time_to_threshold returns true days, and agent-level outputs match expected shape. Verify calibration improves RMSE vs defaults. Ensure optional dependencies are handled gracefully.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run calibration on training window with set random seed and iteration budget; log parameter trajectories and best score. Re-run forecast with calibrated params. Monitor runtime and memory; enable sparse path if large networks.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Report RMSE/MAE/R2 pre- and post-calibration, peak adoption and threshold timings using actual days, and inequality metrics by age and SES (if available). Compare to baseline and document improvements.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide a concise report summarizing changes, calibrated parameters, metric improvements, agent-level output location, remaining limitations, and recommendations for any further iteration.
